title: Hiking in Kopli

Hiking in Kopli

Almost 3 months without going out doing anything as I was locked in doing my thesis 📚. So when I saw this event on Meetup, I immediately clicked attend.

Kopli is the terminal station of Tram 1 and Tram 2 🚋. It is a nice and quiet town surrounded by the sea.
